comparison.objective: Route an electric-fence wire through insulators without conductive contact.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable wire routing through multiple slots.
comparison.success_condition: Released wire occupies all slots, stays at least 1 cm from posts, avoids the table, and leaves the handle hanging free.
comparison.reason: Distributed wire routing is mechanically different from rigid rotary adjustment, setscrew retention, and carriage-stop testing. No additional specs were provided.
